import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
L=Path.cwd();W=str(L/'write_lane.py')

r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(L/'sources/residue.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True);subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',W,'sources/residue.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True);print(r.stdout)
